- The phone number associated with your line
- Your full name and date of birth (for verification)

This will help me check your account and line status for any issues.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Your phone line is currently suspended, which is why you have no service and cannot send messages or use data.

Would you like me to resume (reactivate) your line now? If you know the reason for the suspension or if it was a mistake, please let me know so I can assist you further.
Yes, please reactivate my line. I’m not sure why it was suspended, so any help would be appreciated.

It appears your line cannot be reactivated because the contract for your service ended on 2024-11-30. This is likely the reason your line was suspended.

To restore service, you may need to renew your contract or select a new plan. Would you like information on renewing your contract or choosing a new plan? If you believe this is a mistake, I can also connect you with a human agent for further assistance. Let me know how you’d like to proceed!
